class.name: MaszynaScenarioEventImplementation
class.brief_description: The original's event system as the implementation of a [ScenarioEventServer] event system.
class.description: Forwards to [MaszynaScenarioEventServer] what it keeps of the system's events, memories and launchers: a passive event is not queued, an event of [code]departuredelay[/code] runs after its train's departure, a track's [code]event0[/code] goes on while its vehicle stands there, a launcher's interval fires it, and everything of the system goes when the implementation is detached. Take it from [method MaszynaScenarioEventServer.implementation_get].
